candidate_state: release preparation from the v0.5.0 source commit

nnue_artifact.qualification_scope: Independent colour-reversed material-only 1T and 4T paired-trinomial gates; not an external rating, a default-adoption decision, or a WebAssembly/mobile qualification.

internal_measurement.results: The default material evaluator and ordinary search policy are unchanged. nn_r6 is an optional, non-default release asset qualified on the pinned source commit.

external_opponents.configuration: No external engine, evaluator, weights, labels, Suisho5-derived scores, or Suisho5-derived opening positions are used as release evidence for v0.5.0.

known_limitations: nn_r6 is optional and not selected by default; it has no external-rating or WebAssembly/mobile-quality qualification.
The qualified PGO throughput results apply only to their recorded Apple M4 configurations; ordinary release builds do not embed those profiles.
Parallel search can vary by scheduler; deterministic diagnostics require one thread and SpecTopN=0.
The WebAssembly package is distributed as a GitHub Release asset and is not published to the npm registry.
